description: Enhance the Groups section with daily PnL information and more stats on the group detail page, showing aggregated follower performance.
steps: In src/app/groups/[id]/page.tsx: Add a 'Group Daily PnL' section with mock data showing the sum of all followers' PnL per day. Include a DailyPnlChart (reuse existing component) and a small stats summary (today's PnL, this week's PnL, this month's PnL).

In src/app/groups/[id]/page.tsx: Enhance the Group Summary cards section. Add more stats: Total PnL (sum across all members), Average Risk Multiplier, Total Trades Today, Win Rate. Use mock data derived from the sample members.

In src/components/groups/group-card.tsx: Add a small daily PnL indicator showing today's PnL for the group (e.g. '+$425.00' in green or '-$125.00' in red). This can be a new optional prop 'dailyPnl' on GroupCardData.
In src/app/groups/page.tsx: Add the dailyPnl mock values to the sampleGroups data and display them on the cards.
acceptance_criteria: Group detail page shows daily PnL chart for the group
Group detail page shows enhanced stats (Total PnL, Avg Risk Multiplier, Trades Today, Win Rate)
Group cards on the groups list page show today's PnL
All data uses deterministic mock values
verification: Group detail page contains DailyPnlChart import or equivalent
findings: Build passes successfully with NODE_OPTIONS="" npx next build. The pnpm build command has a preload module issue (proxy-bootstrap.js) but the underlying next build works fine. All three files modified: group detail page, groups list page, and group-card component.
